newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials open in mixed trade, Nasdaq off.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials open in mixed trade, Nasdaq off.

text.p: Wall Street stocks drifted between positive and negative ground on Tuesday before the release of the National Association of Purchasing Managers report .
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up around two points at 7674, after opening higher then moving lower. Advancing issues evenly matched the number of declining issues.
The Nasdaq composite was down more, losing around two points or 0.14 percent to trade at 1440. Both Intel Corp and Cyrix Corp declined after an earnings warning from computer chip maker Cyrix.
